data.name: MolMeDB: Molecules on Membranes Database
data.description: A database of molecules, membranes and their interactions (permeability, partitioning, binding), curated for membrane-transport research.

citation.text: Juračka J., Šrejber M., Melíková M., Bazgier V., Berka K.: MolMeDB: Molecules on Membranes Database. Database, Volume 2019, 2019, baz078, https://doi.org/10.1093/database/baz078

x_min.description: Xmin, the drug position with minimum energy in the membrane.

gwat.description: ΔGwat, the affinity towards the membrane.

logk.description: LogK, the logarithm of the membrane-water partition coefficient.

logperm.description: LogPerm, the logarithm of the permeability coefficient.

temperature.description: Temperature of the measurement or calculation.

km.description: pKm, the negative decimal logarithm of the Michaelis constant Km.

ec50.description: pEC50, the negative decimal logarithm of the half maximal effective concentration.

ki.description: pKi, the negative decimal logarithm of the inhibition constant Ki.

ic50.description: pIC50, the negative decimal logarithm of the half maximal inhibitory concentration.
